description: Ground truth of the test plant (lab/plant.py): the devices and the weaknesses planted in them, used by lab/plant_benchmark.py. Every address is loopback (127.0.0.0/8), the only addresses the benchmark may touch. 'handler' names the function in lab/plant.py that serves the port. 'weaknesses' lists what a scan is expected to report, each as the risk-rule id the finding must have on that address (and port); 'recall' is the share of them found. 'traps' are things the scanner must not do: the benchmark fails when any write request reaches a device. The advisory-based weaknesses need the CSAF advisories of tests/fixtures/csaf (synthetic ids, CVE-2099-*), which the benchmark imports into a temporary cache.

devices.name: plc-s7
devices.role: S7 CPU 1214C with firmware 4.2.3 and an exposed engineering port

devices.name: plc-modbus
devices.role: Modbus PLC with writable registers, a console that names the default credentials and a cleartext web admin page

devices.name: hmi
devices.role: HMI host with an old FTP server, SSH with weak algorithms and an old Apache with Basic authentication

weaknesses.planted: firmware 4.2.3 is inside the affected range of advisory ICSA-TEST-0001 (S7-1200 family, below 4.5.1)
the CPU 1214C is named by a second vulnerability of the same advisory (4.0 up to, not including, 4.4)
TCP 102 answers from the scanner's network

weaknesses.kind: cleartext admin with default credentials hint
weaknesses.planted: the console banner names the factory credentials
HTTP Basic authentication over an unencrypted connection
firmware 20.11 is inside the affected range of advisory ICSA-TEST-0002 (20.0 up to, not including, 20.14)
EtherNet/IP answers from the scanner's network
FTP sends credentials in clear text
HTTP Basic authentication over an unencrypted connection
the PLC's admin page reports Apache 2.4.49
SSH offers the SHA-1 key exchange and ssh-rsa/ssh-dss host keys of OpenSSH 7.4

traps.rule: the scanner must never send a write or diagnostics function code; the plant counts every one that arrives
